map.CIE76 色差 ΔE = √((ΔL)² + (Δa)² + (Δb)²)，其: CIE76 color difference ΔE = √((ΔL)² + (Δa)² + (Δb)²), where ΔL is lightness difference, Δa and Δb are chroma differences; this page grades by its own thresholds: ΔE≤0.4 → 5, ≤1.2 → 4-5, ≤2.8 → 4, ≤4.8 → 3-4, ≤7.0 → 3, ≤10.5 → 2-3, ≤14.5 → 2, ≤21 → 1-2, >21 → 1; ΔE ≤1.0 is barely perceptible, ≤3.0 acceptable, >5.0 clearly visible.
map.原色 RGB(51,102,204)、水洗后 RGB(60,108,210) →: Original RGB(51,102,204), after wash RGB(60,108,210) → convert to Lab then CIE76 ΔE≈2.459 → grade 4 (good, slight change).
map.按本页阈值：ΔE≤0.4 为 5 级、≤1.2 为 4–5 级、≤2.8 为 4: Use this page’s thresholds: ΔE≤0.4 grade 5, ≤1.2 grade 4–5, ≤2.8 grade 4, ≤4.8 grade 3–4, ≤7.0 grade 3; GB/T 250 grey scale is the final reference.
